name: TouchTry Eye Fit
author: touchtry

sections.description:
TouchTry Eye Fit lets WooCommerce stores add an interactive 3D / AR Try-On button to eyewear products.
Shoppers can instantly preview glasses with their phone camera.

Features
* Add AR try-on to any eyewear product
* Works on single product pages (can be extended to shop loops)
* Lightweight, mobile-friendly (uses )
* Customizable “Try On” button text & style
* Supports .glb models
* No coding required

Arbitrary section

TouchTry builds immersive AR shopping tools. Learn more at https://touchtry.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/touchtry-eye-fit/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate TouchTry Eye Fit from Plugins.
  3. Edit a product (Products → Edit) and fill the Eye Fit AR Try-On Link (GLB/model URL).
  4. Update the product.
  5. Open the product page — you’ll see the Try On button.
sections.faq:
Which 3D model format is supported?

GLB (binary glTF).

Does it work on all devices?

Yes — modern mobile browsers (Android Chrome, iOS Safari) and desktops that support WebXR/.
(AR Quick Look / device support may vary by device.)

Can I customize the button?

Yes — edit the plugin’s CSS to change colors, fonts, and placement.
